overview: What would you do if your girlfriend shrank overnight reaching the size of a Barbie doll? This is the incredible story of Minami and his girlfriend Chiyomi. After this bad luck, the two teenagers see their lives turned upside down. Minami must now take care of his miniature girlfriend. He designs clothes, builds a small house to her size, takes her to the bathroom and prepares her mini-meals, but how long can this situation last? Not easy for Chiyomi to become a living toy when she is going through puberty and his hormones titillate her!
title: Minami-kun no Koibito

overview: Chiyomi is a high school girl, who was born and raised in a retro Showa-era shopping district in Shonan. She is a member of the basketball club and has a kind personality that stays cheerful despite her somewhat complicated family structure. She and Minami-kun, also known as Minami Hiroyuki, a basketball star from her hometown of Shonan, have been like siblings since childhood, and they are happily in a relationship. However, one day, he suddenly becomes 15 cm in size and fits in the palm of her hand. Chiyomi begins living with him in his now tiny body.
title: Minami-kun ga Koibito!?

overview: You've seen her dominate South Central Baddies, stir the pot on Deja Vu, and keep it real on Greek Life. Now Joce is taking center stage as the host of the hottest new reality series, where bold personalities and big drama all live under one roof. Expect raw emotions, shocking twists, alliances, betrayals, and unfiltered vibes every episode. This is reality TV like you've never seen before!
title: DollHouse

overview: Diddy on Trial: As It Happened takes you inside the criminal trial of Sean "Diddy" Combs, one of the most salacious and hotly anticipated courtroom showdowns in decades. Watch bombshell moments and heart wrenching testimony unfold in real time through meticulous actor reenactments sourced each week from courtroom transcripts. Prosecutors allege the music icon and business mogul engaged in a dark underworld of sex trafficking and prostitution. Combs denies all accusations, maintaining his innocence. Join host Sunny Hostin as she breaks it all down with a rotating roster of legal and pop culture experts, giving you a front row seat to this high-stakes legal battle.
title: Diddy on Trial: As It Happened

overview: In the Silk Kingdom, fate takes a dark turn on the birth of King Noor Al-Din's second son when the treacherous Golden Uncle kills the king and hunts his heirs. Loyal servant Radwan flees with princes Shams Al-Din and Jalal Al-Din, but they are separated. Shams grows up as a slave soldier, while Jalal survives among outlaws. When they reunite, loyalty and betrayal collide in a battle for power.
title: The Silk Kingdom

overview: Good Morning Britain delivers you the news that you're waking up to in the morning. From exclusive interviews with some of the biggest names in politics and showbiz to heart-warming human interest stories and unmissable watch again moments.
title: Good Morning Britain

overview: The show features prominent real estate experts competing to find the best properties. In this exciting championship, the "real estate gurus" not only search for the best deals available on the market, but also have to convince applicants that the property they are presenting is the best choice for them. They collect points throughout the week, and at the end of the week, the real estate agent who earns the most points wins the grand prize of 3 million forints.
title: Ingatlanvadászok

overview: Oh Seol-Rem was the top student in her grade year at her high school. She got addicted to an online game and failed to enter a university. She is now studying to take her university entrance exam after graduating from high school. She met a male character Tarakexcali in the online game and fell in love with Tarakexcali. She never met him in real life and didn't know anything about him except that he attends Ganghan University. They even promised to marry, but one day, he suddenly disappeared from the online game. She unplugs her computer and studies hard. Finally, Oh Seol-Rem enters Ganghan University where the male character Tarakexcali is attending in real life. She looks around for Tarakexcali.
title: Lead Male Character Search

overview: Two fed-up families take on a 30-day eviction process to finally push their adult children out of the nest - but can they really go through with it?
title: Evict My Kid

overview: Vitya and Serega are collector partners who have been transporting money for a long time, but every now and then something goes wrong. Once again, when the car is attacked by robbers, the guys manage to fight back. They accidentally find out that this robbery was organized by their boss, and in order to take revenge on him, they decide on a desperate move: to rob themselves.
title: Инкассаторы

overview: Heiress He Lingfei, who once lived extravagantly, abruptly severed ties with her college boyfriend after her family went bankrupt. Unbeknownst to her, Lu Yichen was actually an abandoned heir of a wealthy family. After being cast out, he clawed his way back and transformed into a cold-hearted CEO. Years later, they reunite at a banquet where He Lingfei, now a fallen heiress, is busy serving her fiancé. Lu Yichen's eyes blaze with love and resentment: When you left me without a word back then, did you ever think about the man you discarded?
title: Secretly Loving You
Jia Xi Zhen Zuo Hou Ta Yong Shi Suo Ai

overview: Two Years Later is an eight-part romantic dramedy set in a post-pandemic world, following thirty-somethings Emily and Ryan whose brief, daily flirtations on their work commute aboard a bus are abruptly cut off by COVID-19. Two years later, they reconnect unexpectedly, and Ryan impulsively proposes they go on eight dates to decide if they're meant to be married. Together, they navigate personal revelations, unexpected family drama, professional upheavals, and their contrasting worldview - all while discovering genuine intimacy.
title: Two Years Later

overview: Jools Holland presents BBC Two's flagship music show, with legendary musicians and brand new acts from around the world, all performing live.
title: Later... with Jools Holland

overview: A comedy mystery web-series that follows the exploits of three gay bear roommates living together in Los Angeles, as they attempt to solve the murder of a party guest that turned up dead in their bathtub.
title: Where the Bears Are

overview: Shaking Down The Thunder takes an intimate look at the Sydney Swans' journey to break the longest Premiership drought in AFL history, as they chase the 2005 flag. Under the guidance of new wave coach Paul Roos, the beleaguered "Bloods" adopted a new ethos of leadership, brotherhood, commitment and empowerment which resulted in a new brand of football, one that at times raised eyebrows with critics. Lead by a rotating group of captains including Barry Hall, and starring Michael O'Loughlin, Brett Kirk and young guns Adam Goodes, Jude Bolton and Leo Barry, the team would finally take to the hallowed turf at the MCG under blue skies for the AFL Grand Final against West Coast in front of 91,828 passionate fans.
title: Shaking Down The Thunder

overview: In this special Halloween edition full of adventure, manipulation, lies and deceit, celebrities compete against their fellow candidates for a large silver treasure. They know what they are getting into, but can they survive this slasher?
title: De Verraders Halloween

overview: Tiny Time Travel is a series of funny and fast-paced live-action shorts. Tyler, an 11-year-old inventor, and Tony, his outgoing best friend, use their time machine to go back in time a tiny bit (sometimes just a few minutes or hours) to solve problems in their neighborhood. Problems like stopping a friend from spoiling a movie, or giving a customer a re-do after an ordering mistake at a restaurant. Even though Tony and Tyler can only time travel a tiny bit, they always manage to help their friends and neighbors just in time. The series aims to help kids ages 5-8 learn social language skills, like understanding nonverbal communication, taking others' perspectives into account, and resolving miscommunication.
title: Tiny Time Travel

overview: Candinho and his faithful companion, Policarpo, are back for new adventures in the big city. However, his son's disappearance brings new suffering to him, who continues to believe that "everything bad that happens in life is for the better!".
title: Êta Mundo Melhor!

overview: When the body of a young man is found eerily staged in the idyllic Scottish wilderness, detective Monica Kennedy fears this is just the beginning of a terrifying campaign that will strike the heart of a rural community. As paranoia rises, suspicions and secrets are forced into the light, and the locals start to realise that there is a serial killer hidden amongst them. With her experience of dealing with the darkest of humanity Monica Kennedy quickly becomes entangled in a heightened game of cat and mouse with a cunning killer. Only she can stop this monster before he claims any more victims. But when her own history creeps up on her, she begins to lose trust in her own judgement. Will it be her own actions that are the biggest risk to herself and her family?
title: The Dark

overview: The ultimate dating series Blind Date is back - bigger, better, and bolder than ever. The new series will begin in a secret Blind Date location, where contestants must choose between three potential suitors, hidden from view behind the legendary Blind Date wall, the only thing standing between them and their potential true love just metres away. With a host of unique, innovative and head-turning format twists, our daters will see if forever love can truly grow as they spend the summer living together but potential new partners are always lurking behind the wall...
title: Blind Date

overview: Moscow is a city where speed decides a lot. No one is waiting for anyone here. To achieve something, you need to be constantly on the move here. This defines the concept of the show. In each episode, 15 new participants challenge Moscow and its speed. Some of them have already achieved something here (stars), some are just at the beginning of their journey (ordinary people), but they are all on equal terms, and the rules are the same for everyone - you are a fugitive, and hunters are following you. If you can escape, you'll take a large sum. If you get caught, the game is over. Here, everyone decides what to do: unite or be a loner. Try to hide or go ahead.
title: Погоня

overview: Michinari Shiga works as a deputy-editor for weekly magazine Shukan Jiryu, whose sales have risen due to scoops on numerous scandals. He lives the life of a journalist with integrity, until his own university-aged son, murders a couple, then himself. Instead of chasing after scandals, Shiga now finds himself at the centre of one. His situation is now desperate, as fellow journalists hound him, he's demoted to a monthly magazine and his relationship with his wife is quickly deteriorating. But Shiga is determined to expose the truth behind his son's case.
title: Yoru ga Dorehodo Kurakutemo

overview: Otpisani is a 1974 Yugoslav television series set in Nazi-occupied Belgrade during World War II. It follows a group of young Partisan resistance fighters who carry out covert operations against the German forces and their collaborators. Known for its mix of action, suspense, and patriotic themes, the series became a cultural classic in Yugoslavia.
title: Otpisani

overview: Mysterious Places with Stacy Keach is a documentary series that explores the world's most intriguing lost cities, bizarre formations, and sacred sites. The series, hosted by Stacy Keach, investigates locations like the Mayan Yucatan, Loch Ness, and Tombstone, delving into legends surrounding King Arthur and more. It features original footage filmed on location throughout the world.
title: Mysterious Places With Stacy Keach

overview: A heartbreaking and hilarious recounting of Jennette McCurdy's struggles as a former child actor while dealing with her overbearing, domineering mother. The dramedy will center on the codependent relationship between an 18-year-old actress in a hit kid's show, and her narcissistic mother who relishes in her identity as a starlet's mother.
title: I'm Glad My Mom Died

overview: In Scrambled Up, four contestants solve jumbled-up words and phrases that unscramble before their eyes. As the tiles unscramble, the clues get easier. The first player to buzz in with the right answer has a shot at walking away with the $10,000 grand prize.
title: Scrambled Up

overview: In this game show hosted by Neil Patrick Harris, players answer trivia to win spectacular hidden prizes — but can they keep them from the competition?
title: What's in the Box

overview: In 1990s Beijing, a small inn bears witness to the lives of a group of young men and women who have come from all corners of the country, to chase their dreams in the city. Xu Shengli, obsessed with scriptwriting, never gives up despite constant rejection. Singer Zhuang Zhuang, yearning to perform on prestigious stages, can only make a living through commercial gigs. Shen Ranran, hoping to play leading roles, faces opportunities and tough choices in the flashy entertainment industry. Talented cellist Tao Liangliang plays under overpasses, pursuing his musical dreams. Guo Zongbao, a background actor and an artist at heart, juggles odd jobs in order to treat his wife and children's illnesses. Painter Cao Ye, full of avant-garde ideas, struggles in a world that does not understand him. They work tirelessly for their dreams, yet reality is always cruel and unyielding. As the new millennium arrives, some continue to persevere while others are forced to give up, but the flame of art never dies in their hearts.
title: Live Up to Your Youth

overview: Raul Seixas abandons his career as a music producer to become a singer, mixing rock with baião. He adopts a radical style and falls into addictions, but becomes an icon of Brazilian rock.
title: Raul Seixas: Eu Sou

overview: The best of CNN's reporting from correspondents across the world, to guide global audiences through the fast-paced news cycle with insight, analysis and hard-hitting interviews.
title: The Brief with Jim Sciutto

overview: In Baked with Love: Holiday, 10 talented pairs of home bakers face off in a warm-hearted, family-recipe bake-off. They will infuse their heritage, personal stories, and cherished family recipes into classic bakes with a twist and serve their dishes to a panel of expert judges. In the end, one pair will be crowned the Christmas Baking Champions and win the ultimate prize of $50,000!
title: Baked With Love: Holiday

overview: Odd Squad is a Canadian/American children's live action television series that premiered on TVOKids in Canada and PBS Kids in the United States on November 26, 2014, both on the same day. The series is created by Tim McKeon and Adam Peltzman and is co-produced by The Fred Rogers Company and Sinking Ship Entertainment in association with TVOKids and Ici Radio-Canada Télé. The series features young agents who use indirect reasoning and math to solve and investigate strange happenings in their town. This is commonly in the form of satire, or other comedic archetypes, and are used to teach the audience differing lessons in mathematics. In the UK it airs on CBBC and Pop. In Latin America it airs on Discovery Kids.
title: Odd Squad

overview: From deciding what's for dinner to planning family outings (and maybe ven a cheeky splurge), 10 new teens are about to find out what it really takes to run the show. Emma Watkins is back to cheer them on, offer advice and provide the occasional reality check. The teens are not just managing the household budget; they're also saving for their own ambitious goals – from a state-of-the-art drone, to funding a home recording studio or buying their first car. With Emma's guidance they'll face real-life financial challenges teaching both themselves and their parents about money management and independence.
title: Teenage Boss: Next Level

overview: Genius idol Sana's first time being a host in her life! Wanna know about super cute Sana's skill as an interviewer
title: Sana's fridge interview

overview: Popular romance novelist Rakumoto Ai is sent to a remote island to write. There, he meets cheerful tour guide Muto Kaishin. Though their personalities clash, the island's charm slowly softens their hearts, leading them to discover a quiet, healing love.
title: Love Sea: The Home for Lovers

overview: Around the world, wild animals are hooked on human vices -- bears drunk on alcohol, gators high on meth; even "cocaine hippos". Wildlife expert Forrest Galante tracks these animals, investigating their strange behaviors to find ways to rehab them safely.
title: Animals on Drugs

overview: Civics Made Easy breaks down the complex world of American government and civic participation. Each episode transforms intricate concepts into clear, digestible lessons, equipping viewers with the essential knowledge to actively participate in their democracy. Designed to empower and inform, the series makes understanding civics both accessible and engaging for all.
title: Civics Made Easy

overview: The journey will take us from the tiny NSW regional town of Barellan, where an eager eight-year-old Aboriginal kid first peered through the cyclone wire fence of a tennis court to the centre courts of the world, where Evonne would reach the world number one ranking and endear herself to millions around the globe. Along the way, the obstacles will be immense. At age 12, Evonne will leave behind her family to be coached by the imperious Vic Edwards. While the on-court success that follows unites a nation, a deeply disturbing dynamic is playing out behind the scenes that will threaten to tear everything apart. And, when she falls deeply in love with Roger Cawley, Evonne will have to decide whether to follow her heart or follow her career. Or, whether she can do both.
title: Goolagong

overview: Through unprecedented access to archival footage and gut-wrenching eyewitness testimony, Hurricane Katrina: Race Against Time is a gripping historical record of the storm and its aftermath. With unflinching urgency, the series exposes how a natural disaster became a national tragedy. The riveting, moment-by-moment portrayal offers new details of how the storm and ensuing flood unfolded in real time and transports viewers into the chaos that engulfed the city in the days leading up to and following the hurricane's landfall.
title: Hurricane Katrina: Race Against Time

overview: The Vargas, a typical upper-middle Bogotan class family, learning to live together in the middle of the most outrageous and hilarious situations not too far from real life.
title: Dejémonos de Vainas

overview: This in-depth drama demonstrates a mother and daughter-in-law who experience a variety of ups and downs with a lot of mixed feelings.
title: The Mother and Daughter-in-Law

overview: In the near future, a virus has changed the sexual structure of humans, giving birth to a unique ABO system. Sheng Shaoyou, the young master of Shengfang Biology, is young and domineering, and is a top S+Alpha. Because his father is ill, he has to cooperate with Shen Wenlang, the boss of the rival HS Group. Sheng Shaoyou met the mysterious Omega Hua Yong in the hospital, and their feelings grew quietly. Unexpectedly, Sheng Shaoyou is mistaken for an Omega and becomes pregnant. Hua Yong's secrets are gradually revealed, and a brand new world opens up.
title: ABO Desire

overview: In The Rookie: North Alex Holland believed his mid-life wasn't worthy of a crisis. But after a violent home invasion ignites a dormant purpose, Alex battles a lifetime of failed commitments by joining the Pierce County Police Department as its oldest rookie. Policing from the urban coast to the rural forest where backup isn't just 5-minutes away, Alex must prove to his skeptical training officer, his fellow rookies, and himself, that he's finally found something worthy of the fight.
title: The Rookie: North

overview: Investigation of the circumstances of a minor helicopter crash leads to stunning results: the aircraft was shot down from a secret rocket launcher. For a young engineer, Marat, this is a personal tragedy, he loses his fiancee in the accident. But the real tests are just beginning. By a strange coincidence, the life of his new lover is under threat.
title: Оружие

overview: Two years after the events of the previous season, the characters' lives are changing again. Michael and Varya, who are already raising three children, return to Moscow and face unexpected problems after moving, because of which their family will have to learn to live in new circumstances. Anton is trying to build a stable life with Marina and be a father to Polina, but the appearance of her biological father disrupts the usual order and forces him to reconsider his decisions. Besides, Kristina is returning to Moscow. Valya finally achieves professional success, which changes the balance in his family with Masha and puts their relationship under serious pressure. Masha always dreamed of a rich life, but she didn't get exactly what she wanted. The return of Kuzi, who has become a successful businessman, launches a new chain of events, at the center of which is his confrontation with Alla Grishko, now a tough and influential player who is not inclined to look back on the past. Gentle Allochka now has the nickname "snow queen", and she intends to appropriate the business of the "dumpling king" Kuzi.
title: Универ. 15 лет спустя

overview: Fern meets the owners of beloved pets who have appointments at The Grove Vets in Bristol. Vet James Greenwood will take Fern Britton though the range of treatments that The Grove offer include vaccinations, spays and dentistry, as well as surgery and critical care.
title: Fern Britton: Inside the Vets

overview: One is hard to tell, another one is hard-hearted. How will the love of an engineer and a beautiful vice president come true?
title: Somewhere Somehow

overview: The Chase is a quiz show in which four contestants must pit their wits against The Chaser, a ruthless quiz genius determined to stop them winning at all costs. A thrilling battle of brainpower and quick-thinking ensues, with each contestant trying to outrun the Chaser and bank their prize money before the final round, when the surviving team members join forces to try and win thousands of pounds.
title: The Chase

overview: A violent plane crash throws Phinya and Busaya, former PhD classmates turned fierce rivals into a tense reunion on the remote forensic field. Tasked with identifying the deceased, they find themselves tangled in the secrets of a mysterious skull, discovered far from where it belongs.
title: Cranium

overview: Reframe The Game aims to tell untold stories from across women's sport, as part of TNT Sports commitment to ensuring access and representation for all in sports production, both in front of and behind the camera.
title: Reframe The Game

overview: The Premier Lacrosse League All-Star Game is a field lacrosse game played between the best players on two teams representing the Premier Lacrosse League (PLL). The inaugural game took place on Sunday, July 22, during the 2019 season, at Banc of California Stadium in Los Angeles, California.
title: PLL All-Star Game

overview: At Jimmy's Suffolk farm and wildlife refuge, Jimmy welcomes some homeless polar bears, a pack of wolves, and two brown bears looking for their forever homes.
title: Jimmy Doherty's Big Bear Rescue

overview: Four teams of shark experts and enthusiasts travel the globe trying to find the most elusive shark species in this fin-tastic reality competition.
title: All the Sharks

overview: Six days before her little sister's wedding, Zouzou, a 30-year-old single marine engineer, can't bring herself to tell her family that she's leaving the day after the wedding to follow the sardines that have mysteriously deserted Algerian waters. Between gossip about her single status, sessions with a hairdresser, and a friendship in crisis, will Zouzou leave?
title: El'Sardines

overview: Yunjae Park thought his relationship with his girlfriend, Ji-eun, was perfect--until one shocking morning changed everything. Ji-eun has mysteriously transformed into a man overnight! Can the two adjust to this sudden and earth-shattering change? And will Ji-eun ever turn back to who she once was?!
title: My Girlfriend Is the Man!

overview: A dramatic comedy about the lives and loves of six Montreal women in their 20s.
title: Féminin/Féminin

overview: After Noya is killed in a car crash, her father Avner, a retired combat officer, joins forces with Daria her best friend, to investigate Noya's death. Avner discovers that Noya had a secret virtual life, as part of a movement of teenagers swept up in the world of
title: Wonder

overview: Luke Nguyen celebrates the Australia-Vietnam relationship, travelling through Vietnam and meeting Australians who represent the spirit of the relationship, cooking with Australian produce, and enjoying regional Vietnamese dishes.
title: A Taste of Australia in Vietnam

overview: This is more than just a cooking show - it's a backstage pass to a world where food, music, and heartfelt conversation collide. In each episode, the iconic band Bush's frontman Gavin Rossdale designs and prepares a sumptuous four-course meal in his Hollywood Hills home, setting the stage for an unforgettable evening with an A-list guest - Serena Williams, Selma Blair, Tom Jones, Common, Jack McBrayer and Brooke Shields. As they cook, dine, and unwind, these celebrity icons shed their public personas to share raw, unfiltered stories about success, challenges, and the human experience.
title: Dinner with Gavin Rossdale

overview: Pro cook & designer Ellen Bennett works with homeowners to reimagine their kitchens through a chef's eyes. With an emphasis on function, each kitchen is transformed into a beautifully designed space fit for a chef without spending a fortune.
title: Kitchen Glow Up

overview: The drama unfolds around a passionate man who hides his crimes to protect his first love and a middle-aged detective seeking redemption by uncovering a brutal truth. A single fatal mistake. An explosion that takes thirteen lives. Two cases that appear entirely unrelated become entwined through the fates of three young people. Across a decade-long journey of investigation and redemption, a buried truth slowly emerges, exposing a shocking secret at the heart of it all.
title: The Guilty

overview: Award-winning spicy romance novelist Sophie Gravia and TV personality, model and fellow author Christine McGuinness host a rollercoaster ride of funny, bizarre and downright weird stories of when relationships take an unexpected turn. Whether you need advice on life, love, or best pal boundaries, they are here for it all. Think of them as the latest additions to your group chat. Sophie and Christine delve into your dilemmas and let you in on their own lives, with no topic is off-limits.
title: Situationships with Sophie and Christine

overview: Woosang is devastated by the death of his father—and now, even the school track team is about to be disbanded. While everyone urges him to face reality, only Jaemin quietly steps closer to stand by his side.
title: MY IDOL

overview: A school outing turns into a nightmare. Six-year-old Emma has disappeared into the forest. A search party is immediately organized. Then, as if by magic, Emma reappears. Everyone seems relieved, except that now her teacher, Jade, who went looking for her, is missing.
title: Je sais pas

overview: Marriage has many benefits, but in-laws aren't always one of them. Surviving the In-Laws features true accounts of hilarious horror stories about couples.
title: Surviving the In-Laws

overview: The true story of the making of early America.
title: What Really Happened: America's Wild West
Ben Xian Zun Bu Dang Zhui Xu

overview: Britain's Hotel Murders uses contemporary footage, newly-shot interviews with eyewitnesses and experts who can piece together the disturbingly dark narratives of the troubling killers who used hotels as their hunting grounds and unsuspecting hideouts. With compelling first-hand testimonies the series unveils the hidden dangers which the anonymity of overnight stays can present, and the horror stories that have affected the victims to this day.
title: Britain's Hotel Murders

overview: Rapper Toni returns to his hometown for his mother's funeral and suddenly finds himself juggling career dreams and surprise fatherhood to a teenage son.
title: Kacken an der Havel

overview: Three lives intertwine in an unexpected way in the rivers of the Atlantic Amazon: Janalice, a young woman kidnapped by human trafficking; Preá, who needs to come to terms with his destiny as the leader of a gang that operates on the region's rivers; and Mariangel, who seeks revenge for the death of her family. The three will try to survive the "psychic", a curse that they believe has been cast upon them.
title: Pssica

overview: Zhenya is unjustly imprisoned for a car accident on Kutuzovsky Prospekt, in which her husband and 6-year-old daughter are killed. The real culprits of the accident are rich kids whose powerful parents "help" the court make the "right" decision. In the penal colony, Zhenya accidentally saves an influential inmate, Yana, who is serving a sentence for murder. In gratitude, Yana teaches Zhenya how to become stronger in order to take revenge, and helps her escape. Once free, Zhenya gains wealth through Yana's guidance and begins to seek justice against her enemies.
title: Холод

overview: Sher is a gripping Pakistani drama packed with raw emotions, intense rivalries, and deep-rooted traditions. From kidnappings and secret alliances to broken promises and forbidden love, every episode leaves you wanting more.
title: Sher

overview: Promoted to lead anchor of a struggling news program, a journalist pushes the boundaries to investigate and expose truths others want buried.
title: News Anchor

overview: In Once Upon a Christmas, Santa is discouraged by a lack of Christmas spirit and wants to quit, but his daughter, Kristin, begs for one more chance to prove to him that there is hope for the world.
title: Once Upon a Christmas

overview: A young, rookie lawyer with a strong sense of justice joins a top law firm — navigating the complex legal world under a cold, demanding mentor.
title: Beyond the Bar

overview: Chief instructor Seiji Usami trains an elite team of rescue operatives to undergo daring missions in dangerous environments where others fear to go.
title: Pararescue Jumper

overview: Based on testimonies from real-life prisoners and prison guards, Bariau explores the complex interplay between four central characters on both sides of the law – highlighting the profound impact of the decisions they make on themselves and those around them.
title: Bariau

overview: Five candidates sat next to each other in a semi-circle on chairs, which, when a candidate was eliminated, were automatically lowered into the basement of the studio after a visible "buzzer" press from the presenter, thus "sinking" the candidate. The questions came from a wide variety of subject areas and were mostly of a solvable nature. First, each of the five candidates was asked two open questions, with which they could earn one light for the main round for each correct answer. This began with an open question for everyone, which the fastest candidate was able to answer. If they answered correctly, they were allowed to choose a teammate who then had to answer the next question. Three possible answers were then given, one of which was correct. This round was played until one of the candidates answered incorrectly. One of their lights then went out, or if all the lights went out, the contestant was eliminated. The round then continued with an open question to the remaining candidates. If three candidates were eliminated within a certain time, the final was held between the last two remaining candidates. Otherwise, the main round was ended and open questions were put to everyone. The first two candidates to answer a question correctly then played the final. This was played in best-of-five mode with open questions, i.e. the first person to answer three questions correctly won the final.
title: Quizfire

overview: Karma is a true super hero who originates from Hindu mythology, created to withstand the onslaught of the demonic forces of Markesh.
title: Karma

overview: From the dirt tracks of the Red Centre Way in the Northern Territory to the Great Barrier Reef Drive in northern Queensland, Kangaroo Island in South Australia to the waterfalls and windswept beauty of Tasmania's western coast, iconic Grand Pacific Drive south of Sydney to the nerve-jangling drive across the East Alligator River, this is the ultimate open road enthusiast's guide to Australia.
title: Great Australian Road Trips

overview: Smilla's Sense of Snow centers around Smilla Jaspersen, a Greenlandic woman living in Copenhagen, who investigates the suspicious death of a young Inuit boy, Isaiah, who falls from a rooftop. Smilla's unique "sense of snow" and knowledge of Greenland lead her to uncover a conspiracy involving scientific research and a cover-up.
title: Smilla's Sense of Snow

overview: Back in his hometown to escape a scandal, Kyle finds an unexpected connection with Andres, a quiet fisherman. Just as a new life begins to take shape, Kyle's past threatens to unravel everything — and he must decide if love is worth the risk.
title: Hermoso

overview: Wingin' It (originally titled Angel on Campus prior to its debut) is a teen sitcom family series about an Angel-In-Training (Porter Jackson) and his assignment (Carl Montclaire). One half of the friendship is Porter Jackson a centuries-old Angel-In-Training (AIT) who has been sent to Earth to get his angel wings posing as a carefree sixteen-year-old student. The other half is Carl Montclaire, a fifteen-year-old typical high school kid who has been going through a run of bad luck. Little things seem to always be going wrong in Carl's life. For Porter to get his angel wings, he's been given the assignment of making Carl the most popular kid at Bennett High. In season 3, Jane now knows that Porter is an Angel-In-Training and helps him through the various problems he has in his magic.
title: Wingin' It

overview: Reality show web series by South Korean boy group Stray Kids. It features the group taking part in different games and activities.
title: SKZ Code
